Learn / Research notes

Curiosity deserves
good information.

A clear distinction between what a device does, what researchers study, and what a personal session can promise.

01 / THE TECHNOLOGY

Three modes, different experiences.

Elken describes its next-generation GenQi system as combining hydrogen inhalation, hydrogen goggles and hydrogen water. These are different modes of delivery; a study of one mode cannot automatically establish the effects of another.

Elken: GenQi product information ↗ →

02 / BLOOD PRESSURE

Early findings are not a session guarantee.

A 2022 randomised study enrolled 60 adults with hypertension and used a hydrogen–oxygen mixture for four hours a day over two weeks. Some measures improved, while several ambulatory blood-pressure outcomes did not change significantly. That study protocol is not the same as a commercial trial session.

Read the clinical study ↗ →

03 / BLOOD GLUCOSE

Mixed results call for careful language.

A randomised trial of 50 people with type 2 diabetes compared electrolysed hydrogen-rich water with filtered water. It found no significant difference in its primary insulin-resistance outcome and called for larger, longer studies. It does not establish that Farra’s session stabilises blood sugar.

Read the diabetes trial ↗ →

04 / BEAUTY LEARNING

Understand the routine before the promise.

Elysyle’s official Naru Hydra range presents a cleanser, hydrating mist and day/night moisturising steps. This offers background for discussing a skincare routine; it does not establish which products are included in Farra’s coaching package. Confirm products and sensitivities before practical work.

Explore official Elysyle information ↗ →

Keep your medical care in place.

This website provides service and product information, not personalised medical advice. Discuss diabetes, hypertension or other conditions with your clinician. A wellness session is not a replacement for prescribed care.

Research reviewed 26 October 2026. Product descriptions are drawn from manufacturer sources; prices and service details come from the client-supplied promotional materials. Availability and exact package terms are confirmed directly.
